description:
Job Title: AI Engineer
Position Type: Full-Time Contract (40hrs/week)
Contract Duration: Long Term
Work Schedule: 8 hours/day (Mon-Fri)
Work Hours: PST
Location: 100% Remote - (Candidates can work from anywhere in LATAM Countries)
Overview
We are seeking an experienced AI Engineer to drive AI-first engineering practices and enable developer productivity at scale. This role sits at the intersection of Developer Experience, Platform Engineering, Dev Ops, and Applied AI, focused on integrating AI-assisted tooling, LLM workflows, and automation into the software development lifecycle.
The ideal candidate will bring hands-on experience with LLM APIs, AI developer tooling, Python automation, cloud infrastructure, and developer productivity metrics, while helping shape internal AI governance, adoption frameworks, and scalable engineering "golden paths."
Key Responsibilities
Champion an AI-first engineering culture through reusable playbooks, golden-path templates, and best practices that improve developer productivity.
Define and measure impact using DORA and SPACE metrics, driving improvements across engineering workflows.
Build reusable patterns for:
AI-assisted code generation
Pull request automation
Test generation
Debugging workflows
Developer self-service enablement
Evaluate, prototype, and lead POCs for AI tools, providing recommendations based on ROI, usability, technical merit, and stakeholder feedback.
Manage AI usage governance, including:
Token budgeting and cost controls
Usage monitoring and reporting
PII redaction guardrails
Audit logging and responsible AI practices
Develop lightweight AWS-based infrastructure supporting LLM pipelines, APIs, and AI integrations.
Integrate AI tooling into Git Lab CI/CD, Git Ops workflows, and developer platforms.
Instrument AI workflows with observability metrics and usage signals to support adoption and optimization.
Partner with engineering leadership and cross-functional stakeholders to drive AI enablement initiatives. Required Qualifications
8+ years of experience in Platform Engineering, Dev Ops, Developer Experience, or related engineering roles.
Strong hands-on experience with LLM APIs and AI-assisted developer tooling in production or enterprise settings.
Strong Python development skills for automation and AI workflow integrations.
Experience evaluating, procuring, or governing AI/Saa S tools, including vendor assessments, licensing, and cost management.
Practical daily usage of tools such as Git Hub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, Chat GPT, or similar.
Experience designing scalable developer workflows, internal platforms, or self-service engineering capabilities.
Strong AWS experience, ideally including:
Bedrock
API Gateway
Managed AI/Cloud Services
Experience with Terraform, Helm, Git Ops, and CI/CD pipelines (Git Lab preferred).
Strong observability mindset with experience defining meaningful metrics and instrumentation.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills. Preferred / Nice to Have
Experience contributing to an AI Enablement function, Developer Experience program, or Center of Excellence.
Hands-on experience with:
LLM Agents
RAG pipelines
Vector databases (Pinecone, pgvector, Open Search, etc.)
Lang Chain / Llama Index
Exposure to AI Fin Ops, usage reporting, and cost attribution models.
Knowledge of AI governance and security, including:
OWASP Top 10 for LLMs
Prompt injection risks
Model supply chain security
Responsible AI controls
Financial services or insurance domain experience is a plus.

title: Platform engineer / devops engineer em recife (PE)
description:
Job Title: Platform Engineer / Dev Ops Engineer
Position Type: Full-Time Contract (40hrs/week)
Contract Duration: 12+ months with extensions
Work Schedule: 8 hours/day (Mon-Fri)
Work Hours: EST
Location: 100% Remote - (Candidates can work from anywhere in LATAM Countries)
Overview
We're hiring a hands-on Platform / Dev Ops Engineer to join a small, high-impact platform team. This is a "boots-on-the-ground" execution role—not advisory—focused on building, operating, and improving the infrastructure and tooling that enables 100–150 engineers to ship code efficiently and reliably.
You'll work closely with a lean team (Principal + Senior Engineers) and play a critical role in day-to-day platform operations, automation, and developer enablement.
What You'll Do
Operate and improve platform tools to support engineering teams (triaging tickets, resolving build issues, handling access/secrets/env setup)
Manage Kubernetes environments: deployments, Helm charts, namespaces, rollout troubleshooting
Support and enhance CI/CD pipelines (Git Lab CI preferred; Jenkins/Git Hub Actions acceptable)
Maintain and improve self-service workflows, templates, and developer "golden paths"
Work with observability tools (Prometheus, Alertmanager, Thanos, Open Telemetry) to monitor systems and improve signal quality
Assist with service instrumentation across logging, metrics, and tracing
Contribute to documentation: runbooks, onboarding guides, SOPs
Participate in on-call rotation and support incident response
Optimize infrastructure for cost, performance, and reliability
Automate repetitive tasks using scripting (Python/Bash) Must-Have Requirements
6+ years in Platform Engineering / Dev Ops / SRE / Infrastructure roles
Strong AWS experience (IAM, EC2/EKS, S3, Cloud Watch, etc.)
Deep Kubernetes expertise:
Operating and maintaining clusters
Experience building Kubernetes environments
Hands-on Terraform (Infrastructure as Code)
Python scripting (mandatory) for automation and tooling
Experience owning and maintaining CI/CD pipelines
Strong Linux fundamentals
Solid understanding of observability concepts (metrics, logs, tracing) Preferred Qualifications
Experience with Git Lab CI
Exposure to Open Telemetry
API integration or tooling development (Python/Go/Java)
Experience supporting large engineering teams (100+ developers)
Familiarity with security in CI/CD or infrastructure workflows
Multi-cloud exposure (Azure/GCP alongside AWS)
Background in mid-size, modern engineering organizations What We're NOT Looking For
No Kubernetes experience
Bash-only engineers (no Python)
Pure consulting/advisory profiles
Pure security-focused candidates
Heavy enterprise/banking-only backgrounds
ML/Data Science profiles Team Structure
1 Principal Engineer

description:
⚠️International Opportunity! Position is based in Angola!
You will be joining a well-established market leader, large group with diversified businesses portfolio, reporting to the Demand Planning Manager and responsible for the following:
Key Accountabilities:
Develop and maintain accurate demand forecasts for decision-making
Analyze sales data and market trends to improve forecasting
Collaborate with cross-functional teams on factors that impact demand
Monitor sales and refine forecasts based on changing conditions
Communicate forecast updates to supply planning teams
Take ownership and proactively address data quality issues
Create, maintain, and manage visual data tools for leadership
Key Responsibilities:
Review and analyze historical sales data to identify trends and patterns that can be used to improve accuracy of future forecasts
Collaborate with sales, marketing, and other stakeholders to gather information on upcoming promotions, product launches, and other factors that may impact demand
Develop statistical models and algorithms to create accurate demand forecasts for different product types
Continuously monitor and track actual sales performance against forecast and make necessary adjustments to the forecast as needed
Communicate forecast recommendations and updates to stakeholders across the organization, including senior leadership
Ensure that any add/delete items are promptly updated in the system to avoid impacting forecast accuracy
Work with IT and Analytics Data teams to ensure that demand data is available on time for extract and analysis
Validate that sales forecast is pulled into the correct line
Notify the BI team to push data on time to ensure that reporting and analysis can be done in a timely manner
Publish LE (latest estimate) forecasts and other relevant reports to keep stakeholders informed of demand trends and performance
Develop and maintain demand planning dashboard to provide real-time visibility into forecasting and demand planning metrics.
As well as be able to generate reports and visualizations to communicate forecast accuracy, demand trends, and potential risks to stakeholders, enabling informed decision-making
Monitor forecast accuracy and identify areas of improvement to enhance the reliability and precision of demand planning
Provide training and support to end-users on utilizing the demand planning dashboard, ensuring widespread adoption and utilization across the organization
Key Requirements:
Willing and able to work in Angola
Bachelor's Degree as a minimum in relevant field including Finance, Math or Engineering; MBA and/or other professional qualifications are highly preferred
4+ years of Demand Planning experience in a large organization
Strong understanding of supply chain management, logistics, and inventory / production planning

Proficiency in using forecast accuracy KPIs
Strong experience with ERP and demand planning systems (e.g., SAP APO, Oracle Demantra, Kinaxis, Anaplan)
Advanced Excel and data analysis skills; experience with BI tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau)Knowledge of statistical forecasting methods and demand modeling
Solid understanding of distribution networks, inventory management, and supply chain dynamics
Familiarity with S&OP processes and cross-functional planning
Proficiency in analyzing large sets of data and using data visualization tools to identify trends, patterns, and insight
Prior FMCG experience will be a plus
Ability to influence the decision makers
Highest standards of accuracy and precision
Articulate with excellent verbal and written communication skills
Highly-driven and self-motivated
Proven ability to work with ambiguity

O profissional será responsável por atuar na cobrança de forma estratégica e negocial, acompanhando carteiras, conduzindo tratativas com firmeza e identificando oportunidades ao longo do processo.

title: Platform engineer / devops engineer em imperatriz (MA)
description:
Job Title: Platform Engineer / Dev Ops Engineer
Position Type: Full-Time Contract (40hrs/week)
Contract Duration: 12+ months with extensions
Work Schedule: 8 hours/day (Mon-Fri)
Work Hours: EST
Location: 100% Remote - (Candidates can work from anywhere in LATAM Countries)
Overview
We’re hiring a hands-on Platform / Dev Ops Engineer to join a small, high-impact platform team. This is a “boots-on-the-ground” execution role —not advisory—focused on building, operating, and improving the infrastructure and tooling that enables 100–150 engineers to ship code efficiently and reliably.
You’ll work closely with a lean team (Principal + Senior Engineers) and play a critical role in day-to-day platform operations, automation, and developer enablement .
What You’ll Do
Operate and improve platform tools to support engineering teams (triaging tickets, resolving build issues, handling access/secrets/env setup)
Manage Kubernetes environments : deployments, Helm charts, namespaces, rollout troubleshooting Support and enhance CI/CD pipelines (Git Lab CI preferred; Jenkins/Git Hub Actions acceptable) Maintain and improve self-service workflows , templates, and developer “golden paths” Work with observability tools ( Prometheus, Alertmanager, Thanos, Open Telemetry ) to monitor systems and improve signal quality Assist with service instrumentation across logging, metrics, and tracing Contribute to documentation: runbooks, onboarding guides, SOPs
Participate in on-call rotation and support incident response Optimize infrastructure for cost, performance, and reliability Automate repetitive tasks using scripting (Python/Bash)
Must-Have Requirements 6+ years in Platform Engineering / Dev Ops / SRE / Infrastructure roles Strong AWS experience (IAM, EC2/EKS, S3, Cloud Watch, etc.) Deep Kubernetes expertise : Operating and maintaining clusters
Experience building Kubernetes environments
Hands-on Terraform (Infrastructure as Code) Python scripting (mandatory) for automation and tooling Experience owning and maintaining CI/CD pipelines Strong Linux fundamentals Solid understanding of observability concepts (metrics, logs, tracing)
Preferred Qualifications Experience with Git Lab CI Exposure to Open Telemetry API integration or tooling development (Python/Go/Java)
Experience supporting large engineering teams (100+ developers) Familiarity with security in CI/CD or infrastructure workflows Multi-cloud exposure (Azure/GCP alongside AWS)
Background in mid-size, modern engineering organizations
What We’re NOT Looking For
No Kubernetes experience ❌
Bash-only engineers (no Python) ❌
Pure consulting/advisory profiles ❌
Pure security-focused candidates ❌
Heavy enterprise/banking-only backgrounds ❌
ML/Data Science profiles ❌
Team Structure
1 Principal Engineer
1 Senior Engineer
1 Engineer (India)
You = 4th key team member

Sobre a Yever
Somos a fintech de pagamentos feita para quem vive e-commerce de verdade. Nosso checkout de alta conversão já vem com pagamento próprio integrado e conectado aos ERPs, plataformas de marketing e ferramentas de análise que nossos clientes já usam — tudo em um só lugar, tudo funcionando junto.

Apoiar clientes na configuração do checkout e integrações com Shopify, Facebook Ads, Google Analytics, Active Campaign e ERPs.
Investigar e resolver problemas reais de operação, como: Pixel não disparando corretamente.
Eventos do Facebook fora de configuração.
Pedidos aprovados que não sincronizam com o ERP (Bling, Tiny).
Divergências de status de pedido.
Problemas de configuração em lojas Shopify.
Atender clientes via Whats App, chat e e-mail com rapidez e clareza.
Trazer feedbacks do campo diretamente para o time de produto.
O que esperamos de você?
Obrigatório :
Experiência com e-commerce (loja própria, agência ou operação de loja)
Conhecimento prático de Shopify
Noções com Facebook Ads, Pixel/eventos e Google Analytics
Familiaridade com ERP de e-commerce (Bling ou Tiny)
Capacidade de investigar problemas técnicos de integração
Boa comunicação escrita e organização Diferenciais:
Experiência como especialista Shopify ou em agência de e-commerce
Conhecimento básico de APIs, webhooks ou integrações
O que oferecemos? Remuneração de acordo com experiência - com evolução rápida conforme desempenho. Aqui, bom trabalho é reconhecido antes de você precisar pedir: 90% do time já recebeu aumento por iniciativa da Yever.
Plano de saúde (após 12 meses).
Gympass.
️ Gympass pago integralmente pela empresa (após 12 meses).
️ Férias remuneradas (mesmo no modelo PJ).
️ Escritório moderno no Funcionários com ferramentas de ponta.
Por que vir para a Yever?
Estamos crescendo rápido e quem entra agora tem espaço real para deixar sua marca.
Quem determina a velocidade do crescimento é você, sem barreiras!
Você participa da evolução do produto com voz ativa — feedback vira melhoria.
Trabalhamos com gente boa, mão na massa e sem burocracia desnecessária.
Somos apaixonados por e-commerce, tecnologia e pessoas que resolvem.
Aqui, a gente realiza sonhos.
Como é o processo seletivo
Simples e transparente:
Triagem
Entrevista online
Entrevista + roleplay
Entrevista presencial Sem etapas desnecessárias. Sem enrolação.
Ritual oficial da Yever
No seu primeiro dia, a gente almoça junto — por nossa conta.
Já sabe qual restaurante você quer ir?

Compensation: R$350 – R$450 per week (based on tier) + bonuses (based on views)
Probation period: 2 weeks, paid R$250 / week
About Pure
Pure is a bold, global dating app redefining how people connect. We believe dating should be honest, fun, and free of judgment, a space to explore confidence, chemistry, and self-expression.
We’re building a UGC Creator Community of voices to help tell that story.
About the UGC Creator Community
We’re looking for social media creators to join our UGC Pure Dating App Creator Community - a group of UGC content creators producing short-form videos (Tik Tok / Instagram) around themes like dating, confidence, self-love, etc.
As a creator, you’ll have the chance to collaborate with our team, build your personal brand, and get paid to create authentic, engaging content that challenges the way people see dating.
What You’ll Do
Create and post 7 short-form videos per week (Tik Tok / Instagram Reels / You Tube Shorts, etc)
Develop content inspired by dating, connection, and self-expression
Drive people to the app
Participate in creative briefs, trend challenges, and campaigns
Receive feedback and coaching to grow your performance
Collaborate with our team on storytelling ideas and social strategies
What We’re Looking For
You must be based in Brazil and be fluent in Portuguese
Passion for storytelling, social media, and modern culture
Familiarity with Tik Tok trends, Reels formats, and UGC-style videos
Strong on-camera presence and editing skills
Consistency and ability to meet weekly content goals
Open-minded and comfortable creating content about dating and relationships
Payment Structure
Tiered structure paid weekly
Bonuses for views (starting from 100 K+ views)
Bonuses for registrations
Payments are made weekly
Why Join Us
Get paid to create authentic content about dating & self-expression
Access creative guidance, briefs, and a global network of creators
Build your portfolio while collaborating
Enjoy creative freedom - your tone, your story, your perspective
How to Apply
Send us your cover letter and tell us a bit about yourself, including why you’d like to work with Pure app.
You’ll be invited to join a group onboarding call and receive a task to create a test submission video.
After that, you’ll enter a 2-week trial period, and if successful, you’ll be fully onboarded into the program.
Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis.

title: Artificial intelligence engineer em timbó (RN)
description:
Job Title: AI Engineer
Position Type: Full-Time Contract (40hrs/week)
Contract Duration: Long Term
Work Schedule: 8 hours/day (Mon-Fri)
Work Hours: PST
Location: 100% Remote - (Candidates can work from anywhere in LATAM Countries)
Overview
We are seeking an experienced AI Engineer to drive AI-first engineering practices and enable developer productivity at scale. This role sits at the intersection of Developer Experience, Platform Engineering, Dev Ops, and Applied AI , focused on integrating AI-assisted tooling, LLM workflows, and automation into the software development lifecycle.
The ideal candidate will bring hands-on experience with LLM APIs, AI developer tooling, Python automation, cloud infrastructure, and developer productivity metrics , while helping shape internal AI governance, adoption frameworks, and scalable engineering “golden paths.”
Key Responsibilities Champion an AI-first engineering culture through reusable playbooks, golden-path templates, and best practices that improve developer productivity. Define and measure impact using DORA and SPACE metrics , driving improvements across engineering workflows. Build reusable patterns for:
AI-assisted code generation
Pull request automation
Test generation
Debugging workflows
Developer self-service enablement
Evaluate, prototype, and lead POCs for AI tools , providing recommendations based on ROI, usability, technical merit, and stakeholder feedback. Manage AI usage governance, including:
Token budgeting and cost controls
Usage monitoring and reporting
PII redaction guardrails
Audit logging and responsible AI practices
Develop lightweight AWS-based infrastructure supporting LLM pipelines , APIs, and AI integrations. Integrate AI tooling into Git Lab CI/CD, Git Ops workflows, and developer platforms . Instrument AI workflows with observability metrics and usage signals to support adoption and optimization.
Partner with engineering leadership and cross-functional stakeholders to drive AI enablement initiatives.
Required Qualifications 8+ years of experience in Platform Engineering, Dev Ops, Developer Experience , or related engineering roles. Strong hands-on experience with LLM APIs and AI-assisted developer tooling in production or enterprise settings. Strong Python development skills for automation and AI workflow integrations.
Experience evaluating, procuring, or governing AI/Saa S tools , including vendor assessments, licensing, and cost management. Practical daily usage of tools such as Git Hub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, Chat GPT , or similar. Experience designing scalable developer workflows, internal platforms, or self-service engineering capabilities.
Strong AWS experience, ideally including:
Bedrock
API Gateway
Managed AI/Cloud Services
Experience with Terraform, Helm, Git Ops, and CI/CD pipelines (Git Lab preferred). Strong observability mindset with experience defining meaningful metrics and instrumentation.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
Preferred / Nice to Have Experience contributing to an AI Enablement function, Developer Experience program, or Center of Excellence . Hands-on experience with:
LLM Agents
RAG pipelines
Vector databases (Pinecone, pgvector, Open Search, etc.)
Lang Chain / Llama Index
Exposure to AI Fin Ops , usage reporting, and cost attribution models. Knowledge of AI governance and security , including: OWASP Top 10 for LLMs
Prompt injection risks
Model supply chain security
Responsible AI controls
Financial services or insurance domain experience is a plus.

title: Senior backend engineer (golang) em viana (PB)
description:
OPEN TO ALL CANDIDATES ACROSS LATIN AMERICA
Title: Senior Backend Engineer (Golang) – Data Infrastructure & Recommendations
Company: Fulcrum Saa S
Location:  Remote – Latin America (strong overlap with Americas time zones required)
Type: Full-time
Level:  Senior / Staff
Compensation:  USD 70,000–100,000 per year, depending on experience and location
About Fulcrum Saa S
Fulcrum Saa S is a conversion rate optimization (CRO) platform that powers product recommendations for ecommerce brands. Our infrastructure processes high-volume behavioral events, feeds real-time recommendation algorithms, and serves personalized experiences at scale. We operate in a multi-tenant Saa S environment where data correctness, low latency, and system reliability are non-negotiable.
Our stack includes Go, Bigtable, Big Query, Pub/Sub, and a dual-store architecture (operational + analytical) that we designed from scratch.
The Role
We are looking for a senior backend engineer who has built and operated production data systems under real load—not prototypes, not internal tools. This is a core infrastructure role at the intersection of our operational and analytical data layers.
You will own the systems that move behavioral event data from ingestion through transformation into our recommendation engine. You will design for correctness, build for observability, and make architectural tradeoffs with the pragmatism that only comes from production scars.
You will be an early engineering hire with real influence over our technical direction.
What You’ll Do
Design and operate high-throughput event ingestion pipelines capable of processing millions of events per day with low-latency serving requirements.
Own the dual-store architecture that separates our operational (real-time) and analytical (batch) data layers, including streaming vs. batch pipeline design and failure recovery.
Build and maintain data movement infrastructure between stores (Bigtable/Big Query or comparable), ensuring consistency, at-least-once delivery, and graceful degradation.
Instrument production systems: define SLOs, implement distributed tracing, and build alerting that distinguishes signal from noise.
Partner with the recommendation team to evolve our scoring, waterfall, and ranking infrastructure.
Drive architectural decisions on data modeling, schema evolution, and multi-tenant isolation.
Participate in an on-call rotation and own incidents end-to-end—from detection through root cause analysis to postmortem.
What We’re Looking For (Must-Haves)
5–10+ years of hands-on backend engineering in production environments (more is better).
Track record of building and operating high-performance, high-throughput, low-latency systems at scale—not just prototypes.
Deep working knowledge of Go’s concurrency model (goroutines, channels, context, sync primitives)—beyond syntax familiarity.
Experience with columnar or wide-column stores: Bigtable/Big Query strongly preferred; Cassandra, Dynamo DB, Redshift, or Snowflake are comparable.
Hands-on experience moving data between operational and analytical stores—you have solved streaming vs. batch tradeoffs, handled delivery guarantees, and recovered from pipeline failures.
Experience with production observability: metrics, tracing, alerting, dashboards—you know what good instrumentation looks like.
Multi-tenant Saa S experience—you understand isolation, scaling, and noisy-neighbor challenges when serving multiple customers on shared infrastructure.
Batch pipeline design experience—you know when batch is the right tool and how to make it reliable.
Dual-store architecture experience—you have operated systems where the operational and analytical data layers are intentionally separate.
Comfortable working daily in English with a US-based team (meetings, async communication, code reviews, and technical documentation).
Strong Nice-to-Haves
Identity resolution and cross-device stitching (probabilistic or deterministic).
A/B testing infrastructure built for statistical rigor—not just feature flags, but impression tracking, experiment analysis, and statistical significance frameworks.
Recommendation systems experience: scoring heuristics, waterfall algorithms, collaborative filtering, or hybrid approaches.
Ecommerce domain knowledge: attribution models, conversion tracking, order/cart data models, session stitching.
What We Offer
Compensation in the range of USD 70,000–100,000 per year, depending on experience and location, benchmarked to senior remote engineering roles in LATAM.
Remote-first culture with async-friendly practices.
Direct access to leadership; your architectural opinions will be heard and implemented.
A team that treats production reliability as a first-class engineering concern.
How to Apply
Please apply through Linked In with your CV (English) and a brief note highlighting:
Your experience with Go in production.
The most demanding data/throughput system you have owned.
Your country of residence and preferred start date. You can also include links to Git Hub, technical blogs, or talks if available.

Skills – Mar Tech, Digital Asset Management, React.js, Web Application Development, GTM, GA4, Mar Tech Platform Integration
My client who is a leading brand within the CPG industry is currently looking to on board an experienced Mar Tech technical consultant with a strong background working with web development, React.js and within the Digital Asset Management space.
This is a long term contract with 6 month rolling extensions. This will allow individuals to be based 100% remotely.

Experience with Cloudflare Workers, Pages, or Load Balancing

Why you'll love us
We offer a 100% remote position with a monthly home office allowance of R$180.00 and an additional allowance for purchasing items for your office.

title: Investment banking intern em são gonçalo (PI)
description:
Investment Banking Internship - WSO Global Talent Program
Our Global Talent Program offers an unparalleled opportunity to gain hands-on experience and build a formidable resume through an immersive, 10-week virtual internship.
We are actively screening thousands of top students globally to identify future finance leaders. This highly selective program is offered in partnership with leading boutique investment banks in key markets, including the US, UK, APAC, Europe, MENA markets.
Only two students are selected per quarter for this off-cycle, ongoing program, ensuring a focused and high-impact experience for our interns per geographic region.
What You'll Gain: Intensive Financial Training (Weeks 1-2): The internship kicks off with two weeks of rigorous, in-house virtual training led by industry experts. You'll gain a strong foundation in core investment banking skills, including: 3-Statement Financial Modeling
Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) Analysis
Trading Comparables (Comps)
Precedent Transactions
Advanced Excel & Power Point techniques
Industry Research & Sourcing Strategies
Real-World Experience (Weeks 3-10): Following successful completion of the initial training and assessments, you'll be introduced to a Managing Director or Partner at one of our boutique investment bank partners. For the next eight weeks, you'll work directly on live projects, providing invaluable support with: Pitch Book Development
Valuation Analysis (Comps, DCFs)
Financial Modeling
Sourcing & Due Diligence
Industry and Company Research
And other critical tasks to support ongoing deals.
Mentorship & Feedback: Our partner firms are committed to providing a structured learning environment with a minimum of one 30-minute weekly call for deliverables, feedback, and guidance. This ensures you're actively engaged and continuously developing.
This is an unpaid internship designed for high-potential students seeking practical experience and a significant resume boost. The value lies in the rigorous training, direct exposure to real investment banking work, and the mentorship from experienced professionals.
Who We're Looking For:
This program is ideal for highly motivated 1st year and 2nd year students (not limited to) who are eager to get a head start in investment banking and build a compelling CV. We seek candidates who are hungry, quick learners, and committed to excelling in a fast-paced environment.
How to Apply:
Get your application in now! If selected, you will be invited to complete a short assessment. Top candidates from this assessment will move forward to the intensive training phase.
This is your chance to gain an unparalleled edge in your finance career. We look forward to reviewing your application!

Strong American accent with excellent English communication skills (spoken and written)

Ability to thrive both independently and as part of a collaborative team in a fast-paced environment

title: Operations director em manaus (MA)
description:
Kinetic Homes - Operations Director
Introduction:
Kinetic Homes is a homebuilder based in Jacksonville FL focused on expanding homeownership by constructing high quality, affordable homes in vibrant neighborhoods. The business was founded by Erik Nordahl and has built & sold over 100 homes over the past 3 years.
This role will be an early hire in a rapidly growing organization. The individual for this role will report directly to the founder, Erik Nordahl. Mentorship and professional development are critical to Erik, and he will seek to assist his colleagues in their professional development and share the learnings he has accumulated throughout his career. This individual will have opportunity to eventually manage a team of individual contributors in the future.
Compensation: $40,000-90,000 USD per year.
Duties & Responsibilities:
Permitting
Ensure all necessary permits are obtained for new construction projects.
Complete and submit permit applications for new construction.
Assist with septic permits and HOA applications.
Address permit application rejections in a timely manner.
Facilitate communication between surveyors, architects, engineers, etc. via email and phone.
Regularly call and email vendors and city officials to ensure timely deliverables.
Maintain database to ensure files are updated with all necessary documentation.
Maintain a knowledge of and be prepared to answer questions about the status of permits for all new construction.
Development Support
Prepare permit packages to be sent to our field development team.
File required documentation through online portals to be recorded with the appropriate county.
Procurement
Regularly solicit updated pricing among vendors to ensure we are obtaining competitive pricing.
Request purchase orders for active jobs that are under construction.
Check invoices from vendors to ensure that invoiced amounts match master pricing agreements.
Transaction Support
Prepare drafts of Purchase & Sale contracts.
Assist team in due diligence process coordination for all transactions.
Maintain closing calendars for transactions to ensure team is aware of key deadlines and terms.
Qualifications:
University degree. Four or more years of successful experience in a professional work environment
Strong skills in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel) and Adobe PDF.
Interest and use of latest AI technology products is key. Interest and curiosity in how to streamline operations through AI and technology is viewed positively.
Possess strong verbal and written English skills.
Must be highly organized and attentive to detail.
Willing to work in high-pressure environment.
Willing to be responsive and communicative.
Availability is key. Candidate must be willing to respond to time-sensitive requests outside of normal working hours. Normal working hours are 9 AM to 5 PM EST.
The team member may occasionally be asked to work weekends, but that is abnormal.
Good attitude necessary.

title: Executivo de contas em santa luzia (RN)
description:
Estamos contratando: Account Executive | SIGGA Technologies
Você já atuou com manutenção industrial, gestão de ativos ou soluções SAP (especialmente SAP PM)? Então essa oportunidade pode ser para você.
Na SIGGA, buscamos um(a) Account Executive com forte perfil consultivo, capaz de conectar tecnologia ao negócio e gerar valor real para nossos clientes. Mais do que vender, queremos alguém que entenda a dor do cliente — especialmente em ambientes industriais — e saiba traduzir isso em soluções estratégicas.
Quem somos?
Com presença na América Latina, América do Norte, Europa e Ásia, a SIGGA está inserida nas rotinas industriais das maiores empresas do mundo. Somos movidos por inovação e pela Indústria 4.0, ajudando nossos clientes a aumentarem eficiência, produtividade e confiabilidade na gestão de ativos com SAP.
Por que essa experiência é importante?
Nosso diferencial está em entender profundamente o contexto operacional dos nossos clientes. Ter vivência com manutenção, EAM ou SAP PM permite uma atuação muito mais estratégica, com conversas de alto nível e foco em geração de valor.
O que você vai fazer:
Conduzir o ciclo completo de vendas (end-to-end)

Atuar de forma consultiva com grandes contas
Trabalhar em parceria com pré-vendas e times internos
Gerenciar pipeline e oportunidades via CRM
O que buscamos:
Experiência como Account Executive em ambiente B2 B
Vivência com vendas consultivas de software (modelo Saa S / ARR)
Experiência com grandes contas
Conhecimento em CRM
Diferencial importante: experiência com SAP, manutenção, gestão de ativos ou soluções como IBM Maximo, Oracle EAM

Vale Refeição/Alimentação

title: Marketing ai agent builder em parnamirim (RN)
description:
Role Overview:
As our Marketing AI Agent Builder, you will be the lead architect for our \"agentic\" marketing stack. Your goal is to move beyond simple automation (if-this-then-that) toward autonomous systems that reason through marketing data, execute multi-channel campaigns, and self-correct based on performance. This is a \"Builder\" role—part Engineer, part Strategist, part Data Scientist. This is a remote role with the option to work anywhere in NA.
Core Responsibilities:
• Intelligent Research & Segmentation: Deploy agents to crawl the web for intent signals (hiring changes, funding, news) to dynamically update ICP segments and enrich CRM records in real-time.
• Autonomous Campaign Management: Build agents that independently monitor live campaigns (Search, Social, Email) and autonomously reallocate budgets or pause underperforming creatives based on real-time ROI.
• Dynamic Lead Nurturing: Design agents that use Natural Language Processing (NLP) to \"read\" prospect behavior and trigger personalized, multi-step nurture sequences without manual intervention.
• Performance & Guardrails: Establish \"human-in-the-loop\" protocols and evaluation frameworks to ensure agent outputs align with brand voice and security standards.
• System Orchestration: Connect AI agents to our core stack—including Hub Spot/Salesforce, 6sense, and Google Analytics—ensuring seamless data flow and automated write-backs to the CRM.
Qualifications & Skills:
• Experience: 2–4 years in Growth Engineering, ideally with experience scaling a mid-market Saa S revenue engine.
• AI Tooling: Proficiency with agent orchestration frameworks (e.g., Lang Graph, Crew AI) or low-code builder platforms (e.g., Claude Co Work, Code X)
• Agent Orchestration: Experience with low-code/no-code platforms (e.g., Clay, Zapier Central, Make.com) or code-based frameworks (e.g., Lang Graph, Crew AI).
• Prompt Engineering: Ability to design complex \"reasoning loops\" that prevent hallucinations and ensure professional, brand-aligned output.
• Data Savvy: Comfortable working with JSON, APIs, and RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) to feed agents the right context from your company’s internal knowledge base.
• Marketing Expertise: Knowledge of B2 B buyer journeys, attribution models, and demand generation tactics.

title: Investment banking intern em rio verde (CE)
description:
Investment Banking Internship - WSO Global Talent Program
Our Global Talent Program offers an unparalleled opportunity to gain hands-on experience and build a formidable resume through an immersive, 10-week virtual internship.
We are actively screening thousands of top students globally to identify future finance leaders. This highly selective program is offered in partnership with leading boutique investment banks in key markets, including the US, UK, APAC, Europe, MENA markets.
Only two students are selected per quarter for this off-cycle, ongoing program, ensuring a focused and high-impact experience for our interns per geographic region.
What You'll Gain: Intensive Financial Training (Weeks 1-2): The internship kicks off with two weeks of rigorous, in-house virtual training led by industry experts. You'll gain a strong foundation in core investment banking skills, including: 3-Statement Financial Modeling
Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) Analysis
Trading Comparables (Comps)
Precedent Transactions
Advanced Excel & Power Point techniques
Industry Research & Sourcing Strategies
Real-World Experience (Weeks 3-10): Following successful completion of the initial training and assessments, you'll be introduced to a Managing Director or Partner at one of our boutique investment bank partners. For the next eight weeks, you'll work directly on live projects, providing invaluable support with: Pitch Book Development
Valuation Analysis (Comps, DCFs)
Financial Modeling
Sourcing & Due Diligence
Industry and Company Research
And other critical tasks to support ongoing deals.
Mentorship & Feedback: Our partner firms are committed to providing a structured learning environment with a minimum of one 30-minute weekly call for deliverables, feedback, and guidance. This ensures you're actively engaged and continuously developing.
This is an unpaid internship designed for high-potential students seeking practical experience and a significant resume boost. The value lies in the rigorous training, direct exposure to real investment banking work, and the mentorship from experienced professionals.
Who We're Looking For:
This program is ideal for highly motivated 1st year and 2nd year students (not limited to) who are eager to get a head start in investment banking and build a compelling CV. We seek candidates who are hungry, quick learners, and committed to excelling in a fast-paced environment.
How to Apply:
Get your application in now! If selected, you will be invited to complete a short assessment. Top candidates from this assessment will move forward to the intensive training phase.
This is your chance to gain an unparalleled edge in your finance career. We look forward to reviewing your application!

title: Investment banking intern em rio branco (PI)
description:
Investment Banking Internship - WSO Global Talent Program
Our Global Talent Program offers an unparalleled opportunity to gain hands-on experience and build a formidable resume through an immersive, 10-week virtual internship.
We are actively screening thousands of top students globally to identify future finance leaders. This highly selective program is offered in partnership with leading boutique investment banks in key markets, including the US, UK, APAC, Europe, MENA markets.
Only two students are selected per quarter for this off-cycle, ongoing program, ensuring a focused and high-impact experience for our interns per geographic region.
What You'll Gain: Intensive Financial Training (Weeks 1-2): The internship kicks off with two weeks of rigorous, in-house virtual training led by industry experts. You'll gain a strong foundation in core investment banking skills, including: 3-Statement Financial Modeling
Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) Analysis
Trading Comparables (Comps)
Precedent Transactions
Advanced Excel & Power Point techniques
Industry Research & Sourcing Strategies
Real-World Experience (Weeks 3-10): Following successful completion of the initial training and assessments, you'll be introduced to a Managing Director or Partner at one of our boutique investment bank partners. For the next eight weeks, you'll work directly on live projects, providing invaluable support with: Pitch Book Development
Valuation Analysis (Comps, DCFs)
Financial Modeling
Sourcing & Due Diligence
Industry and Company Research
And other critical tasks to support ongoing deals.
Mentorship & Feedback: Our partner firms are committed to providing a structured learning environment with a minimum of one 30-minute weekly call for deliverables, feedback, and guidance. This ensures you're actively engaged and continuously developing.
This is an unpaid internship designed for high-potential students seeking practical experience and a significant resume boost. The value lies in the rigorous training, direct exposure to real investment banking work, and the mentorship from experienced professionals.
Who We're Looking For:
This program is ideal for highly motivated 1st year and 2nd year students (not limited to) who are eager to get a head start in investment banking and build a compelling CV. We seek candidates who are hungry, quick learners, and committed to excelling in a fast-paced environment.
How to Apply:
Get your application in now! If selected, you will be invited to complete a short assessment. Top candidates from this assessment will move forward to the intensive training phase.
This is your chance to gain an unparalleled edge in your finance career. We look forward to reviewing your application!

title: Content creator em cabedelo (PB)
description:
Localização:  Remoto
Tipo:  Freelance / Contrato
Remuneração:  R$350–R$450 por semana (de acordo com o nível) + bônus (com base em visualizações)
Período de teste:  2 semanas, pago R$250 / semana
Sobre o Pure
O Pure é um aplicativo de namoro global e ousado que está redefinindo a forma como as pessoas se conectam. Acreditamos que o namoro deve ser honesto, divertido e livre de julgamentos — um espaço para explorar confiança, química e autoexpressão.
Estamos construindo uma comunidade de criadores UGC para ajudar a contar essa história.
Sobre a Comunidade de Criadores UGC
Estamos procurando criadores de conteúdo para redes sociais para se juntarem à nossa Comunidade de Criadores UGC do Pure — um grupo que produz vídeos curtos (Tik Tok / Instagram) sobre temas como namoro, confiança, amor-próprio, entre outros.
Como criador, você terá a oportunidade de colaborar com o nosso time, desenvolver sua marca pessoal e ser pago para criar conteúdos autênticos e envolventes que desafiam a forma como as pessoas enxergam o namoro.
O que você vai fazer
Criar e postar 7 vídeos curtos por semana (Tik Tok / Instagram Reels / You Tube Shorts, etc.)
Desenvolver conteúdos inspirados em namoro, conexões e autoexpressão
Direcionar pessoas para o app
Participar de briefings criativos, tendências e campanhas
Receber feedback e orientação para melhorar sua performance
Colaborar com o time em ideias de storytelling e estratégias sociais O que buscamos
Você deve estar baseado no Brasil e ser fluente em português
Paixão por storytelling, redes sociais e cultura contemporânea
Familiaridade com tendências do Tik Tok, formatos de Reels e conteúdo UGC
Boa presença em frente às câmeras e habilidades de edição
Consistência e capacidade de cumprir metas semanais de conteúdo
Mente aberta e conforto para criar conteúdos sobre namoro e relacionamentos Estrutura de pagamento
Estrutura por níveis com pagamento semanal
Bônus por visualizações (a partir de 100 mil views)
Bônus por registros
Pagamentos realizados semanalmente Por que se juntar a nós
Seja pago para criar conteúdo autêntico sobre namoro e autoexpressão
Acesso a orientação criativa, briefings e uma rede global de criadores
Construa seu portfólio enquanto colabora com a gente
Liberdade criativa — seu estilo, sua história, sua perspectiva Como se candidatar Envie sua carta de apresentação e conte um pouco sobre você, incluindo por que gostaria de trabalhar com o app Pure.
Você será convidado para uma call de onboarding em grupo e receberá uma tarefa para criar um vídeo de teste.
Depois disso, você entrará em um período de teste de 2 semanas e, se for aprovado, será totalmente integrado ao programa.
As candidaturas são analisadas de forma contínua.

Estamos em busca de um(a) Analista de Cobrança para integrar nosso time!
O profissional será responsável por atuar na cobrança de forma estratégica e negocial, acompanhando carteiras, conduzindo tratativas com firmeza e identificando oportunidades ao longo do processo.

title: Senior data engineer em dourados (CE)
description:
Who We Are: We are a fast growing business and technology consultant company co-founded in 2019. We offer a custom-tailored, white-glove engineering service fit for our clients, because a digital transformation is more than just technology. With a successful track record of being a preferred vendor for Fortune 500 companies and as a trusted partner for some of the industry’s leading companies, our global talent has helped many clients achieve their goals.
The 3 G’s of RE:
“Get Shit Done.”
“Get Over Shit.”
“Give a Shit.”
What You’ll Do:
Design and build Spark data ETL pipelines on AWS data platform.
Collaborate with cross functional teams such as data scientists, fraud, marketing and other business stakeholders to understand their data needs and deliver reliable solutions.
Optimize data infrastructure - Design and maintain robust data infrastructure by using modern data platform architecture.
Ensure data quality and reliability.
Innovate and follow best practices.
Ensure operational excellence of the data platform, including monitoring, incident response, performance optimization, and continuous improvement.
Who We’re Looking For:
Professional experience working in data warehousing, data architecture, and/or data engineering environments, especially using spark, hadoop, hive etc with solid understanding of streaming pipelines.
Proficiency in at least one high-level programming language (Scala, Java, Python or equivalent)

title: Customer service representative em dois irmãos (RN)
description:
Customer Service Representative
Location: Fully Remote (LATAM)
Job Type: Full-Time
Love helping people and solving problems fast? We’re looking for someone who can deliver high-quality customer experiences at scale, while keeping every interaction clear, human, and efficient. This is a hands-on role where responsiveness, empathy, and execution matter every day.
About Uproot Clean
Uproot Clean is a fast-growing, performance-driven consumer brand built for pet owners. We create high-performance, eco-friendly cleaning solutions designed to make life easier without compromising sustainability.
Customer experience is at the core of our brand. Every interaction matters, and how we show up for our customers directly impacts retention, trust, and growth.
The Role
This is a high-volume, execution-focused role. You will manage day-to-day customer interactions across multiple channels, ensuring fast, accurate, and human responses.
You are not just answering tickets—you are shaping how customers experience the brand.
This Role Is For You If:
You communicate clearly, empathetically, and efficiently
You are comfortable handling high volumes of customer interactions
You stay calm under pressure and solve problems quickly
You pay attention to details and don’t let things slip
You take ownership of issues until they are fully resolved
You are comfortable working independently in a remote environment
This Role Is NOT For You If:
You avoid dealing with difficult customers
You prioritize speed over accuracy and quality
You are not comfortable multitasking across platforms
What You'll Do
Customer Support Execution
Manage and respond to customer inquiries via email and support platforms
Ensure fast, accurate, and high-quality responses at scale
Maintain a consistent and professional brand voice Social Media Support
Respond to DMs and comments across platforms like Instagram, Facebook, and Tik Tok
Engage with the community while maintaining brand tone and consistency Order & Refund Management
Process order changes, cancellations, refunds, and exchanges
Ensure all actions follow company policies and are accurately executed Conflict Resolution
Handle complaints with empathy and clarity
Investigate issues thoroughly and provide complete resolutions Cross-Functional Collaboration
Share customer feedback and recurring issues with internal teams
Help identify patterns that can improve product or operations
Requirements
Must have: Experience in customer service (ecommerce or DTC preferred) Strong written communication skills in English Experience handling social media interactions is a strong plus High attention to detail and ability to multitask
Comfortable working in fast-paced environments Work Requirements
⏰ Schedule: Monday-Friday, 8:00 AM - 5:00 PM EST
Workspace: Fixed, professional setup required (stable internet + backup plan)
Benefits & Compensation Fully remote - work from anywhere in LATAM. Paid time off Flex days. Enjoy an extra quarterly day off to unwind and recharge energies whenever you desire Ownership & autonomy - trusted to build and execute strategy
Professional development - opportunities to learn and grow with the business Ready to Apply?
If you care about delivering great customer experiences and want to be part of a fast-moving team, apply now.

Optimize infrastructure forcost, performance, and reliability
Automate repetitive tasks using scripting (Python/Bash)Must-Have Requirements

DeepKubernetes expertise:
Operating and maintaining clusters

Experience owning and maintainingCI/CD pipelines
StrongLinux fundamentals

Experience supportinglarge engineering teams (100+ developers)

Background inmid-size, modern engineering organizationsWhat We’re NOT Looking For

Heavy enterprise/banking-only backgrounds ❌
ML/Data Science profiles ❌Team Structure

title: Customer service representative em teresina (PI)
description:
Customer Service Representative
Location: Fully Remote (LATAM)
Job Type: Full-Time
Love helping people and solving problems fast? We’re looking for someone who can deliver high-quality customer experiences at scale, while keeping every interaction clear, human, and efficient. This is a hands-on role where responsiveness, empathy, and execution matter every day.
About Uproot Clean
Uproot Clean is a fast-growing, performance-driven consumer brand built for pet owners. We create high-performance, eco-friendly cleaning solutions designed to make life easier without compromising sustainability.
Customer experience is at the core of our brand. Every interaction matters, and how we show up for our customers directly impacts retention, trust, and growth.
The Role
This is a high-volume, execution-focused role. You will manage day-to-day customer interactions across multiple channels, ensuring fast, accurate, and human responses.
You are not just answering tickets—you are shaping how customers experience the brand.
This Role Is For You If:
You communicate clearly, empathetically, and efficiently
You are comfortable handling high volumes of customer interactions
You stay calm under pressure and solve problems quickly
You pay attention to details and don’t let things slip
You take ownership of issues until they are fully resolved
You are comfortable working independently in a remote environment
This Role Is NOT For You If:
You avoid dealing with difficult customers
You prioritize speed over accuracy and quality
You are not comfortable multitasking across platforms
What You'll Do
Customer Support Execution
Manage and respond to customer inquiries via email and support platforms
Ensure fast, accurate, and high-quality responses at scale
Maintain a consistent and professional brand voice Social Media Support
Respond to DMs and comments across platforms like Instagram, Facebook, and Tik Tok
Engage with the community while maintaining brand tone and consistency Order & Refund Management
Process order changes, cancellations, refunds, and exchanges
Ensure all actions follow company policies and are accurately executed Conflict Resolution
Handle complaints with empathy and clarity
Investigate issues thoroughly and provide complete resolutions Cross-Functional Collaboration
Share customer feedback and recurring issues with internal teams
Help identify patterns that can improve product or operations
Requirements
Must have: Experience in customer service (ecommerce or DTC preferred) Strong written communication skills in English Experience handling social media interactions is a strong plus High attention to detail and ability to multitask
Comfortable working in fast-paced environments Work Requirements
⏰ Schedule: Monday-Friday, 8:00 AM - 5:00 PM EST
Workspace: Fixed, professional setup required (stable internet + backup plan)
Benefits & Compensation Fully remote - work from anywhere in LATAM. Paid time off Flex days. Enjoy an extra quarterly day off to unwind and recharge energies whenever you desire Ownership & autonomy - trusted to build and execute strategy
Professional development - opportunities to learn and grow with the business Ready to Apply?
If you care about delivering great customer experiences and want to be part of a fast-moving team, apply now.

Nosso foco é oferecer serviços financeiros de alta qualidade, com precisão, organização e atendimento personalizado.
Sobre a Vaga
Estamos em busca de um(a) Bookkeeper / Auxiliar Contábil para atuar em regime presencial e tempo integral . O(a) profissional será responsável por manter registros financeiros precisos, apoiar operações contábeis diárias e colaborar com a equipe de contabilidade e impostos. Manter registros financeiros organizados e atualizados

description:
Junte-se a nós no Orbia Building & Infrastructure: Onde o propósito ganha vida.

Você é movido por propósitos. Mentalidade de crescimento. Pronto para ampliar seu potencial. Bem-vindo ao negócio de Construção e Infraestrutura da Orbia, Wavin, onde nosso propósito de "promover a vida em todo o mundo" impulsiona toda a nossa equipe global.

Todos os dias, estamos pensando grande e trabalhando de forma inteligente para resolver alguns dos desafios mais difíceis que impactam o mundo. Seja facilitando a água potável para as comunidades, criando cidades resilientes ao clima ou projetando espaços de vida mais confortáveis, nunca nos contentamos com o "bom o suficiente" quando há uma oportunidade de tornar a vida melhor.

Onde o propósito ganha vida, ele muda vidas. É para isso que trabalhamos. E quanto a você?

Na Orbia Building & Infrastructure, promovemos a vida em todo o mundo construindo ambientes saudáveis e sustentáveis. E onde é que a nossa ajuda é mais necessária? Os lugares em que vivemos: cidades onde a água potável está vazando, o verde está desaparecendo, as ruas estão inundando após fortes chuvas e sistemas de esgoto desatualizados estão poluindo nossas águas subterrâneas. É hora de fazer parte do nosso time e ajudar a construir ambientes mais sustentáveis!

Estamos atualmente procurando uma Pessoa Apontadora de Logística para se juntar a nós em Suape/PE na Amanco Wavin. Se você quer fazer a diferença e trabalhar para uma empresa com propósito, verifique os requisitos necessários.

Obs. Essa é uma vaga afirmativa para Pessoas com Deficiência (PCD).

Como Pessoa Apontadora de Logística você vai realizar o apontamento periódico dos produtos fabricados, confrontando a quantidade física com a quantidade parametrizada no sistema, através das ordens de produção.

Principais desafios da função

  • Realizar o apontamento e recebimento dos produtos acabados, intermediários e scraps através do sistema informatizado (SAPEX e WMS);
  • Realizar o apontamento de refugos dos lotes retrabalhados utilizando o BAC e o formulário de Lote Bloqueado (LB);
  • Acompanhamento e solicitação das ordens de produção nas linhas, para que as quantidades ordenadas sejam rigorosamente obedecidas;
  • Analisar a programação de produção e solicitar ajustes quando necessário, ex: solicitação de ordem de produção para uma linha que já ultrapassou a ordem;
  • Verificar possíveis não conformidades no material (deformidade na bolsa, falta de anéis, coloração, etc), deixando o material segregado na fábrica e comunicar o controle de qualidade para avaliação e de deliberação (aprovado, retrabalho ou scrap);
  • Realizar a contagem física dos materiais acondicionados nos unitizadores, confrontando com o parâmetro no sistema (via coletor);
  • Cadastrar os unitizadores individualmente no sistema SAPEX, garantindo o envio deste para a utilização na produção;
  • Utilização de paleteira elétrica para a movimentação dos unitizadores e pesagem dos mesmos nas balanças;
  • Realizar os apontamentos de forma a garantir que os percentuais de sobrepeso estejam dentro dos parâmetros pré-estabelecidos;
  • Realizar a limpeza e zelar pela organização do local de trabalho, e também dos equipamentos utilizados no apontamento e movimentação (coletores de dados, computadores e paleteira elétrica);
  • Auxiliar nas atividades de inventários.

Como requisitos básicos, você deve ter

  • Ensino Médio completo;
  • Conhecimentos básicos de informática.

Você se sestaca, se tiver

  • Conhecimento em sistema SAPEX/WWS;
  • Experiência com operação de transpaleteira;
  • Experiência com coletores de dados;
  • Experiência com sistema de gerenciamento de estoque.

O que o Orbia Building & Infrastructure oferece

Quer fazer a diferença trabalhando com um propósito? Aqui assumimos a responsabilidade uns pelos outros e pela nossa empresa. Continuamos corajosos na busca de riscos calculados que alimentam a inovação. E abraçamos a diversidade em perspectivas, habilidades e talentos para transformar a maneira como trabalhamos e o impacto que temos no mundo. Acima de tudo, incentivamos todos os nossos colaboradores a desenvolverem seus talentos e a se tornarem a melhor versão de si mesmos. Juntos, como uma equipe forte, crescemos e cumprimos nosso propósito todos os dias. Orbia B &I é o lugar para estar se você realmente deseja causar um impacto. Além de trabalhar com uma equipe profissional e entusiasmada em um ambiente internacional, oferecemos um pacote competitivo de remuneração e benefícios.

title: Dagtilbudsleder til Troldehuset i Lem em luís eduardo magalhães (BA)
description:
Er du optaget af pædagogisk udvikling, faglig ledelse, legen som metode, relationer, fællesskab og nærvær, så læs videre, for så er det dig vi mangler.

Vi søger en fagligt stærk, nærværende og synlig leder til vores dagpleje, vuggestue og børnehave for 0-6-årige. Du bliver en vigtig del af ledelsesteamet i Helheden Lem, hvor samarbejde, faglighed og glæde er i centrum.

Ledelsesteamet i Helheden Lem består udover dig af en Helhedsleder, Viceskoleleder og SFO-leder. Vi har et tæt samarbejde, og selvom vi har egne ansvarsområder, står vi altid klar til at hjælpe hinanden og kvalificere beslutninger, udvikling og processer. Vi prioriterer et stærkt samarbejde i hele helheden til glæde for børn, forældre og personale.

I Helheden Lem bidrager alle medarbejdere til løsningen af vores kerneopgave, som vi i fællesskab har formuleret.

Med fokus på dannelse, læring og trivsel, skaber vi læringsmiljøer i en dagligdag, hvor børn og unge bidrager til og indgår i forpligtende fællesskaber, og derigennem udvikler livsduelighed.

Vi tilbyder

  • En lederstilling, hvor du følger børnene gennem første del af deres liv – fra dagpleje/vuggestue til skole.
  • En god arbejdsplads i udvikling med dygtige og engagerede medarbejdere og glade børn.
  • Et stærkt lokalområde med stor opbakning og fællesskab.
  • Gode muligheder for faglig udvikling og tæt sparring i ledelsesteamet omkring Helheden Lem.

Vi søger dig, der

  • er pædagogisk uddannet og har mod på ledelse.
  • er nærværende, tilgængelig og synlig i hverdagen – både for børn, personale og forældre.
  • brænder for kvalitet, udvikling og gode læringsmiljøer i dagtilbud.
  • er god til at skabe tydelige organisatoriske rammer.
  • værdsætter samarbejde med medarbejdere, forældre og lokalsamfund og anerkender og bruger medarbejdernes styrker og kompetencer.
  • styrker samarbejde og den faglige sparring mellem dagplejer, Troldehuset og skolen.
  • Har blik for pædagogisk udvikling, de pædagogiske læreplaner, KIDS og evaluering.

Vores mål for børnegruppen er: at skabe en tryg og positiv atmosfære, hvor omsorg/nærvær, glæde, åbenhed og respekt er nøgleordene i vores daglige arbejde.

I hverdagen skal legen være i centrum og være med til at danne grundlaget for det enkelte barns socialisering og samarbejdsevne, så det bliver i stand til at være rummelig og anerkendende over for andre mennesker.

Vi har fokus på inklusionen i forhold til hele børnegruppen. Vi bestræber os på at skabe et værdifuldt fællesskab, som er rummeligt og giver plads til alle. Et fællesskab hvor der er gode udviklingsmuligheder for det enkelte barn.

Tiltrædelse pr. 1 juli, eller hurtigst muligt derefter, da vi gerne venter gerne på den rette. Ansøgningsfrist er søndag d. 10. maj, hvorefter der vil ske en indkaldelse til samtaler. Ansættelsessamtaler forventes afholdt i uge 21.

Vi glæder os til at byde dig velkommen i vores fællesskab.

Vi skal oplyse dig om, at ved eventuel fremtidig ansættelse ved Ringkøbing-Skjern Kommune, vil der være krav om anvendelse af dit private MitID til identitetssikring ved aktivering af IT-brugerkonto.

Medarbejderne i Ringkøbing-Skjern Kommune er vores vigtigste ressource. Vi understøtter det gode liv og væksten. Vi går efter de gode løsninger sammen med borgere, virksomheder og andre gode relationer. Vores arbejde er båret af viden, som vi hele tiden udvikler. Vi lærer af enhver opgave – både som enkeltperson, team og organisation. Læring er en del af hverdagen. Vi er og bliver rige på natur i Danmarks største kommune. Naturen er kilden til det gode liv og til at skabe vækst. Det går vi efter. Det lykkes, fordi vi forkæler ildsjælene og arbejder sammen på tværs.

Seu sistema elétrico é composto por mais de 31 mil km de circuitos (cerca de 28 mil em operação e 3,4 mil em construção), incluindo ativos próprios e controlados em conjunto, e 137 subestações próprias (129 em operação e oito em construção) com tensão de até 550 kV. Seu acionista controlador é a empresa colombiana ISA, que detém 35,82% do capital total.

description:

O Sistema Educacional Brasileiro S.A. (SEB) é hoje uma das mais sólidas e respeitadas instituições educacionais do Brasil, administrando diversas escolas próprias situadas em diferentes estados do Brasil. Com respeito, seriedade e competência, estamos há 50 anos construindo destinos de sucesso pessoal e profissional, certos de que educação de qualidade e valores humanos podem construir as bases de uma sociedade em que queiramos e mereçamos viver.

O(a) Supervisor(a) Escolar é responsável por acompanhar, orientar e garantir o bom funcionamento da rotina pedagógica e organizacional do segmento sob sua responsabilidade, assegurando a qualidade dos processos de ensino e aprendizagem, o cumprimento dos horários, a mediação de conflitos e a articulação entre professores, estudantes, famílias e equipe pedagógica, em consonância com o Projeto Político-Pedagógico da escola.

  • Acompanhar diariamente a rotina do segmento escolar sob sua supervisão, garantindo o cumprimento dos horários de entrada e saída dos professores em sala de aula.
  • Monitorar e organizar os horários de lanche, recreio, almoço e demais momentos coletivos, zelando pela segurança e bem-estar dos estudantes.
  • Atuar na condução e mediação de conflitos entre estudantes, entre professores e entre professores e estudantes, em articulação com a Orientação Escolar e a equipe gestora.
  • Acompanhar rotinas específicas, quando necessário, como:
  • Horários de almoço;
  • Momentos de banho;
  • Organização de transições entre atividades.
  • Supervisionar e orientar os registros pedagógicos e administrativos das atividades desenvolvidas pelos professores e assistentes.
  • Garantir a comunicação clara, respeitosa e contínua das rotinas escolares às famílias, utilizando os canais institucionalmente definidos pela escola.
  • Apresentar o segmento de sua responsabilidade a famílias interessadas e clientes em potencial ao longo de todo o ano letivo, contribuindo para a fidelização e captação de alunos.
  • Registrar, acompanhar e analisar os principais indicadores pedagógicos do segmento (frequência, desempenho, engajamento, evolução das aprendizagens), propondo ações de melhoria quando necessário.
  • Orientar professores e assistentes pedagógicos para o pleno desenvolvimento de suas atribuições, promovendo alinhamento pedagógico e boas práticas educacionais.
  • Organizar e acompanhar a elaboração dos horários escolares, garantindo equilíbrio, funcionalidade e atendimento às necessidades pedagógicas.
  • Atuar de forma integrada com a Direção, Coordenação Pedagógica e Orientação Escolar, contribuindo para a tomada de decisões e o fortalecimento da cultura escolar.

Formação Acadêmica

  • Graduação completa em Pedagogia ou em Licenciatura (qualquer área da educação).
  • Especialização na área pedagógica (Coordenação, Supervisão, Gestão Escolar ou áreas afins) será considerada um diferencial.

Conhecimentos e Competências

  • Conhecimento das rotinas escolares e dos processos pedagógicos da Educação Básica.
  • Noções da BNCC e dos princípios do Projeto Político-Pedagógico.
  • Capacidade de mediação de conflitos e atuação colaborativa.
  • Habilidade de organização, planejamento e acompanhamento de indicadores pedagógicos.
  • Boa comunicação oral e escrita, especialmente no relacionamento com famílias.
  • Postura ética, empática e proativa.
  • Capacidade de liderança, orientação de equipes e tomada de decisão.
  • Domínio básico de ferramentas digitais para registros e comunicação escolar.

Horário à definir (segunda a sexta) 44h semanais

  • Assistência Médica;
  • Assistência Odontológica;
  • Ticket Alimentação;

Com seis décadas de pioneirismo no cenário educacional, o Grupo SEB estabeleceu-se como uma comunidade global, vibrante e multicultural, pautada pela excelência em educação. Formamos uma rede composta por mais de 7 mil agentes de transformação, dedicados a ampliar as oportunidades para mais de 400 mil estudantes em aproximadamente 40 países.

Na vanguarda das tendências e inovações em educação, somos um grupo educacional brasileiro sólido e diversificado.

Nosso portfólio de negócios inclui marcas amplamente reconhecidas no mercado, abrangendo desde a educação básica até o ensino superior. Além disso, oferecemos soluções educacionais personalizadas que capacitam cidadãos globais.

Nosso propósito vai além da transformação educacional: “Conectamos estudantes globais e os empoderamos para criar futuros de impacto, expandindo suas oportunidades por meio da excelência e inovação.”

Aqui, você se tornará parte de uma cultura que celebra a paixão pela aprendizagem e o compromisso em impactar positivamente o futuro por meio da educação.

Vem com a gente fazer parte de um grupo global de educação!
